rules.reason: Recursive force delete (rm -rf) is blocked: destructive and irreversible. Remove specific paths explicitly, or get a human to run this outside the agent.
Piping a downloaded script straight into a shell (curl ... | sh) executes unverified remote code. Download, inspect, then run deliberately.
Privilege escalation / disk-wiping / fork-bomb patterns (sudo, chmod 777, mkfs, dd if=, fork bombs) are blocked for AI-initiated commands.
Editing .env files is blocked: they hold secrets and credentials. Manage environment configuration through your secrets manager, not the agent.
Writing .env files is blocked: they hold secrets and credentials. Manage environment configuration through your secrets manager, not the agent.
Reading private keys and credential files (id_rsa, *.pem, ~/.aws/credentials) is blocked to keep secrets out of the model context.
